consequence.statement: Certificate renewal requests for proxies deployed at the same time will now be distributed with randomized jitter (±approximately 15 minutes around the default 12-hour renewal period) instead of occurring simultaneously.

original.statement: Environment variable `SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER` was added with default value `0.01` to introduce randomized jitter in certificate renewal timing, preventing synchronized renewal requests across proxies.

decision.reason: [ev-d0223398edc4] says a new default (`SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER`=0.01) adds a randomized offset of about +/- 15 minutes to the 12-hour certificate renewal. Renewal still works, just at slightly different times, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. The proposed statement matches the evidence's wording.
